input.question: Defend the Spend review of pr-015: please itemize the lab supplies and publication costs in this request with vendors and dates, and confirm each was allocable to R21AI182745 and placed before the project end date.

grant.title: Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity

purchases.item: Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods

leftOut.why: Ordered in this period but not invoiced yet, so not spent.

answer.answer: Two purchases in payment request pr-015 fall under lab supplies and publication costs, both charged to grant R21AI182745. Request rq-033 is lab supplies: 40 packs of agar plates from vendor MicroMedia, ordered 2026-04-14 for $1,180, serving the aim of assay validation runs. Its invoice was paid at $1,180 and received 2026-04-20. Request rq-035 is a publication cost: an open-access publication fee to J. Appl. Microb. Methods, ordered 2026-04-24 for $2,100, serving the aim of publishing the beta-lactam assay paper. Its invoice was paid at $2,100 and received 2026-04-30. Both were ordered and charged to this grant for the research aims stated above, which is the basis for confirming they are allocable to R21AI182745. Both order dates fall before the project end date of 2026-08-31. The request's purchases subtotal is given as $3,280 and its personnel subtotal as $5,130, which together make up the $8,410 total for the period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30. Item rq-034, an orbital plate shaker for $6,200, was left out of this request because it was ordered in the period but not invoiced yet, so it is not claimed.
